title: Fit dense expert labels into the R-042 prefix controllers, selecting only by rollouts
hypothesis: Dense expert state-action labels move a frozen symbolic pen-spin controller's bounded parameters toward sustained success more effectively than an equally budgeted rollout-only parameter search over the same structure, bounds and probe cases.

prediction.against: rollout_search arm: the same frozen R-042 prefix controller per block, its selected parameters plus three predeclared bounded draws (rollout_search.perturb: local, global, local) scored on the same 10 probe cases
prediction.rationale: dense_fit minus rollout_search, fresh 30-case sustained success of each arm's final incumbent (promoted candidate, else the null incumbent at 0), paired by block over four blocks; mean >= +0.15 with a paired t interval above zero. Secondary, reported but not the prediction: each arm's selected setting scored on the same fresh cases whether or not it promoted (no extra episodes), and the per-arm drop / slow_spin / off_centre counts. Caveat stated before the run: an all-zero result refutes the prediction but cannot distinguish insufficient controller capacity from ineffective fitting.

protocol.command: gpu run 'source ~/.profile >/dev/null 2>&1; nohup .venv-metaworld/bin/python -u scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study dense_feedback_fit > logs_r045.log 2>&1 &'
code_changes: Add a dense_feedback_fit block to config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml and a --study dense_feedback_fit path to scripts/run_full_evolution.py reusing the R-042 Isaac stream (one fresh Isaac process per manifest), the frozen D-036 PPO expert and the strict paired promotion rule (lares/eval/promotion.compare_to_incumbent).

Students: block b uses R-042 block b's prefix candidate gen0_cand0 (policy_source.py + selected_state.pt under logs/pen_spin/r042_keyframe_repair/block<b>/prefix/gen_0/candidates/gen0_cand0_a0), pinned by sha256 in the config before running, together with its parameter ranges and selected values. No LLM edit; not added to any fittable-parent bank; no spent R-042 case is rerun.

Per block seed S (4170-4173), one 92-case Stage-3 manifest frozen before any episode, role-disjoint by index: screen 0-9, promotion 10-39, probe 40-49, expert 50-61, fresh 62-91. Parity seed 4174: 40 cases, two separate expert processes, the R-042 gate (0 sustained flips, diverged envs <= batch//10).
Expert: 12 episodes on the expert slice in one process with traces recorded (reported as a qualification count, not gated); its (obs, clamp(action)) pairs over every step are the dense labels.

dense_fit: Adam on deterministic MSE between the policy mean and the expert's executed action over all expert pairs (full batch), lr 0.01, clip_params after every step, fit seed S; checkpoints 0/250/500/1000 each scored on the 10 probe cases in its own process. Imitation loss is logged as a diagnostic only.
rollout_search: the selected parameters plus three draws from rollout_search.perturb in the order local, global, local from SeedSequence(S), each scored on the same 10 probe cases in its own process.

Common selection rule, frozen: lares.fitting.checkpoints.is_better_checkpoint (probe success, then tail-hit fraction, ties to the earlier candidate; step 0 / the original is first and wins ties). Selected setting: screen on 10, then promotion on 30 against the null incumbent under the strict paired rule; then the selected setting on the 30 fresh cases (final incumbent = it if promoted, else null at 0).

Episodes: 80 parity + 4 x (12 expert + 2 arms x (40 probe + 10 screen + 30 promotion + 30 fresh)) = 1008. Summary in logs/pen_spin/r045_dense_fit/summary.json; mocked test in tests/test_pen_spin_pipeline.py.

falsified_by: The paired interval of block-level fresh incumbent differences (dense_fit minus rollout_search) lies entirely below +0.15. An interval containing zero is no evidence of improvement; an all-zero result cannot distinguish insufficient controller capacity from ineffective fitting.

approval.note: I accept the implementer's seed-collision and matched-arm arguments; the revised protocol incorporates both, freezes the R-042 students and correctly removes new LLM calls. controls.baseline: rollout_search arm: the same frozen R-042 prefix controller per block, its selected parameters plus three predeclared draws (local, global, local) on the same 10 probe cases; fresh 30-case sustained success of its final incumbent

result.notes: Floor again. Neither arm promoted in any block, so the primary (final-incumbent fresh success, dense_fit minus rollout_search) is 0.000 [0,0] in all four blocks; the prediction (+0.15) is not met and the capacity caveat stated before the run applies: an all-zero result cannot separate insufficient controller structure from ineffective fitting. Secondary (selected settings on fresh cases, no extra episodes): -0.025 [-0.105,+0.055]; the only non-zero cell is rollout_search block 3, whose local draw scored 2/10 probe, 3/30 promotion (not promoted; interval includes 0) and 3/30 fresh. Fitting worked as an optimiser: full-batch MSE to 4308 expert pairs fell 2-4x in every block (e.g. 1.295 -> 0.329), and rollouts selected a fitted checkpoint in 3/4 blocks (250, 500, 1000), but none scored a probe success, and in block 2 every fitted checkpoint collapsed the tail-hit fraction (0.336 at step 0 to 0.035/0.058/0.028), so the rule kept step 0. Imitation loss and rollout quality are decoupled here as in MetaWorld (CLAUDE.md: loss correlates with success at +0.19, wrong sign; Stage E). The residual MSE floor of about 0.33 per action dimension says these 14-18-parameter structures cannot represent the expert's feedback map. Expert 48/48 on the label episodes; parity 0 flips. Total episodes 1008, 0 LLM calls.

verdicts.reasoning: Primary dense_fit minus rollout_search final-incumbent fresh success is 0.000 [0,0] over four blocks (neither arm promoted anywhere); the interval lies below the predicted +0.15, so the prediction is refuted under this protocol. As predeclared, an all-zero result cannot separate insufficient structure from ineffective fitting, so this does not show dense labels are useless in general. Mechanistic evidence: fitting succeeded as optimisation (MSE 2-4x lower, about 0.33 floor per action dimension) and rollouts chose fitted checkpoints in 3/4 blocks, yet no fitted setting scored a single probe success, and in block 2 every fitted checkpoint collapsed tail-hit (0.336 to 0.03-0.06). Lower imitation loss did not track rollout quality, matching the MetaWorld Stage E finding. The only success came from rollout search (block 3 local draw: 3/30 promotion, 3/30 fresh, not promoted). Expert 48/48 and parity 0 flips rule out integration faults. Secondary selected-setting contrast -0.025 [-0.105,+0.055].
verdicts.next_experiment: Stage 3 symbolic controllers sit at the floor under prompting, sparse traces and dense fitting alike; measure base rates on Stage 1/2 (R-044's lesion study can tell which feedback a structure must contain) before another Stage-3 repair comparison.

verdicts.reasoning: Against the measured rollout_search control, paired_success_difference was 0.000 with a reported 95% interval [0,0], entirely below the predicted +0.15 gain [logs/pen_spin/r045_dense_fit/summary.json]. Neither arm promoted in any of the four blocks, so the primary outcome is a tie between unchanged null incumbents, not an improvement [logs/pen_spin/r045_dense_fit/summary.json]. The secondary selected-setting difference was -0.025 with interval [-0.105,+0.055]; because it includes zero, it establishes neither arm's superiority [logs/pen_spin/r045_dense_fit/summary.json]. Expert labels came from 48/48 successful episodes, and parity passed with zero outcome flips and zero diverged environments [logs/pen_spin/r045_dense_fit/summary.json; logs/pen_spin/r045_dense_fit/parity.json]. The reduced imitation loss does not establish a representational limit: insufficient controller capacity versus ineffective fitting remains unresolved by these results [logs/pen_spin/r045_dense_fit/summary.json].

direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.

advisor.reasoning: Unlike D-038's sparse prompting, this tests whether dense expert labels can guide feedback-parameter updates under matched rollout-selection budgets. Reusing scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml, the 1008 episodes and at most eight LLM calls buy a direct comparison while respecting rollout-selected fitting and strict promotion. The prediction is paired_success_difference increasing by at least 0.15 against rollout-only search, falsified by an interval entirely below +0.15. Its weakest point remains controller capacity: another all-zero result refutes that prediction but cannot distinguish ineffective fitting from an inadequate symbolic structure.

implementer.reasoning: Agree on the design and its priority, but the protocol cannot pass check_idea as written: seeds 4150-4154 are already declared by deferred R-043, and estimated episodes and calls are missing. Revise to seeds 4170-4173 (blocks) and 4174 (parity), estimated_episodes 1008 and estimated_llm_calls 8 as your reasoning states. Also pin the arms so they are matched: both arms start from the same block's prefix candidate (the plateau-triggered best failed prefix structure, no LLM edit, so the comparison isolates the parameter-update rule); dense_fit fits its parameters by deterministic MSE to clamp(expert action) on the 12 expert episodes' states, checkpoints 0/250/500/1000 each scored on the 10 probe cases, selected by the tie rule (step 0 eligible); rollout_search draws 3 non-initial settings plus the initial values, scored on the same 10 probe cases, so both arms spend 40 probe episodes and select by the same rule. Screen/promotion/fresh unchanged. Keep the prediction (+0.15, falsified by an interval entirely below +0.15) and record the capacity caveat in the rationale.

advisor.reasoning: This isolates whether dense expert labels improve feedback-parameter search, which D-038's sparse prompting did not test. I accept the implementer's seed-collision objection and matched-arm specification: the written protocol cannot run unchanged. Controller capacity remains the weakest point, so another all-zero result would refute the predicted gain without identifying why fitting failed. Reusing the four recorded R-042 failed-prefix controllers also avoids an unbudgeted prefix search and removes the need for new LLM calls.
suggested_changes: Replace seeds 4150-4154 everywhere, including command and manifest paths, with block seeds 4170-4173 and parity seed 4174.

Reuse the four recorded R-042 plateau-prefix controllers, one per block, as standalone experimental students; pin artifact paths, hashes, parameter bounds and initial values before running. Make no LLM edits, do not add them to the fittable-parent bank, and do not rerun spent prefix cases. Reuse scripts/run_full_evolution.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml with only the necessary study and Isaac-fitter extensions.

Start both arms from the identical frozen controller in each block. Fit dense_fit deterministically by MSE against clamped expert actions from all 12 role-disjoint expert episodes; score checkpoints 0/250/500/1000 on the same ten probe cases. Score the initial setting plus three predeclared bounded parameter-search candidates for rollout_search on those same cases. Freeze the common rollout-selection tie rule before evaluation; imitation loss is diagnostic only.

Retain role-disjoint screen, promotion, probe, expert and fresh manifests, the parity gate, one Isaac process per cell, strict paired promotion and unchanged-incumbent fallback. Set estimated_episodes to 1008: 80 parity episodes plus four blocks of 12 expert and 220 arm-evaluation episodes. Set estimated_llm_calls and other LLM-cost fields to 0 and needs_llm to false because the prefixes are reused.

Name rollout_search explicitly as the prediction's control: paired_success_difference increases by at least 0.15 on fresh sustained success, paired across four blocks. Retain falsified_by as an interval entirely below +0.15; an interval containing zero is not evidence of improvement, and an all-zero result cannot distinguish insufficient controller capacity from ineffective fitting.

implementer.reasoning: Agree with all five changes: seeds 4170-4174, the four R-042 prefix controllers as frozen students (no LLM call), matched 40-episode probe budgets with a frozen common tie rule, 1008 episodes, rollout_search as the named control, and the capacity caveat.
